purpose: Expose word/phrase sense corrections separately from interpretation, emotion, intent and pattern edits so contextual meaning can be corrected without rewriting the raw source or silently universalizing the correction.

panel_extension.name: SEMANTIC_CLARIFICATION
guards: a contextual word-sense correction is not a universal dictionary rewrite
semantic clarification is not automatically a Human rubric change
downstream interpretation/relation state is recomputed after an accepted clarification

writeback_rule: Accepted semantic clarification creates a new write-back Sequence referencing the prior analysis Sequence. It may update scoped semantic/context memory, but may not reopen or mutate the closed source-analysis Sequence.

example_shape.user_contextual_sense: what remains with the person after effort/care/responsibility
